position: Private backend spike accepted for continued prototyping
headline: The local source path is useful enough to harden, but not ready to host publicly.
copy: The review separates proof of packet behavior from production approval.

postures.title: Source packet contract
postures.copy: Citation, family, confidence, reviewer state, rights state, and boundary stay visible.

postures.title: No-source behavior
postures.copy: Unsupported claims return a refusal packet instead of invented evidence.

postures.title: Private demo
postures.copy: The local server and browser fallback can be demonstrated without accounts or storage.

postures.title: Production service
postures.copy: Security, identity, rights, monitoring, and operations are not implemented.

postures.title: Public launch
postures.copy: The spike is evidence for the next build, not launch authorization.

flow.title: Check
flow.copy: Run source packet and route safety contracts.

flow.title: Decide
flow.copy: Continue the local Node path for one bounded integration slice.

flow.title: Lock
flow.copy: Keep production storage, telemetry, payments, and public launch closed.

decisions.label: Spike decision
decisions.reason: The local Node path proves contracts with the smallest operational surface.

decisions.label: Next work
decisions.reason: Typed errors and request traceability come before richer retrieval.

decisions.label: Deployment
decisions.reason: No hosted backend is authorized by this gate.

decisions.label: Launch
decisions.reason: Private demo evidence is not public readiness.

locks.title: Live AI lock
locks.copy: No live model call is enabled.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: No durable user, reviewer, telemetry, or account storage is created.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: No licensed translation or corpus delivery is assumed.

locks.title: Authority lock
locks.copy: VedaPath remains source-backed study and reflection support, not a guru or clinician.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Private demo readiness does not authorize public launch.

packet:
